axis_supply.notes: By May 1943, division completely cut off from resupply. Fuel and ammunition critically low. Many vehicles abandoned due to lack of fuel. Surrender inevitable due to supply exhaustion.

allied_supply.supply_status: Adequate for defensive operations, strained for offensive operations. Primary constraint: fuel and ammunition delivery from Algiers (600km) and Tunis port facilities after capture. Moroccan Goumiers highly effective at living off local resources. Division recently re-equipped with mix of French and US Lend-Lease equipment.
